boundaries.title: 2024 Cartographic Boundary File, State and Equivalent Entities for United States, 1:500,000
boundaries.coordinate_processing: Shapefile-to-GeoJSON conversion only; no rounding, simplification, smoothing, hand redrawing, or AI generation.
boundaries.precision_limits: The Census cartographic dataset is itself an officially simplified 1:500,000 representation for small-scale mapping, not a cadastral survey or a legal boundary determination. A projected map and raster video cannot be literally exact at all physical scales.
boundaries.included: All 50 states and District of Columbia (51 features); all source polygon parts and islands retained.

excluded_territories.name: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

boundaries.rendering_caution: Composite projections may clip the Aleutian Islands or northwestern Hawaiian Islands. Use unclipped separate fitted Alaska and Hawaii projections to retain the complete state geometry.

political_classification.title: Official 2024 Presidential General Election Results
political_classification.method: Extract Harris and Trump statewide popular-vote totals from PDF pages 3 and 5, verify 51 records and national candidate totals, then compare vote counts per state.
